==Description==
'''Garry's Dance''' is the starter [[Emotes|emote]] obtained upon joining the game for the first time. As it is only given for free to players that joined after the [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], it can also be bought in the store for {{Coins|1,000}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/109517370/profile MRePotatoes]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is a reference to a ''Garry's Mod'' emote which can be seen by typing "''act dance''" in the developer console.
*This emote used to share its music with the [[Whip]] emote.
